answer: Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 145 bonds yet holds one position, and the walnut report publishes the merged exposure. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the vine funding graph is rebuilt from the thread history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 145 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
